description: Rename a file in the artist's Library, give it a short description, set the artist's own tags, or link it to one song or album, as the file's Edit in the Library does. Only what you pass changes; tags replaces the whole set. It overwrites what was there (the answer says what it was), so tell the artist what you change. Limits: name 120 characters, description 500, up to 20 tags of 40 characters, stored lowercase.

album_id.description: Link it to this album (from list_albums). Clears a song link.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

description.description: A few words about it; null clears it.

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key if you retry, and the change happens once.

name.description: The file's name; null goes back to its own name.

tags.description: The artist's own tags, the whole set; [] clears them.

track_id.description: Link it to this song (from list_tracks). Clears an album link.

unlink.description: true: take it off its song or album.

name: update_media
title: Organize a Library file
